Name: Fire Brew
Description: Ash on the tongue. A river-singer learns to burn.
Notes: YOUR EXAMPLE. A Lorelei counts as a Brandteufel for the match and gains two abilities. Feeds goals_with_brew_fire.

Name: Water Brew
Description: Cold and deep. The fire goes quiet and learns to listen.
Notes: The mirror of the Fire Brew. Needs the Water Craft talent.

Name: Keeper's Tonic
Description: Thick, bitter, and it makes you very hard to move.
Notes: No Becomes and no For Class - anyone may drink it, nobody changes class, they just gain a defend ability. Permanent is blank so it always wears off.

Name: Lorelei Team Spirit
Description: Everyone drinks from the same cup. Whatever was in it, they are one side now.
Notes: THE TEAM SPIRIT, forged in the class tree when all three Lorelei nodes hold a Star. Note what it is: AN ORDINARY ROW OF THIS FILE. The tree unlocks the name in Requires and does nothing else, so you can rewrite the drink completely - the element, both abilities, the price, whether it is permanent - without touching a line of code.

Name: Feuergeister Team Spirit
Description: Ash in the cup and ash on the tongue. Nobody flinches.
Notes: The same for the other class. Its Requires is the name the tree unlocks - spelled exactly as ClassTree.spirit_unlock() builds it: the words Team Spirit and then the class name.

Name: Rhine Water Lager
Description: Cold from the river. Three of these and he hears her singing.
Notes: A TURNING BREW (round X). Drinks 3: three pours on a plain card and he becomes a Lorelei at his own tier and power, keeping his name. On the third the Pub asks which card he becomes - one per set. A different element in between starts the count again.

Name: Rauhnacht Smoke Beer
Description: Smoked over the twelve nights. Three, and something answers.
Notes: Turning brew - fire. Same rules as turn_water.

Name: Miner's Dunkel
Description: Black as the seam and twice as heavy.
Notes: Turning brew - earth. Same rules as turn_water.

Name: Unken Weisse
Description: Cloudy, cold, and it croaks a little.
Notes: Turning brew - air. Same rules as turn_water.

Name: Helles
Description: A clean, golden Mass. Nobody becomes anybody, they just start to sing.
Notes: ROUND AN - THE DRUNK METER. INSPIRATION is how much of the meter (DrunkLevels.csv) one of these fills, in %. Blank = 0. A row with no Becomes and no abilities is a PLAIN BEER: it only fills the meter, and it is the only thing a sober player can be given. Free, so a team can always start drinking. DRAFT.

Name: Festbier
Description: Stronger than it looks. Two of these and the Tuba sounds like the Rhine.
Notes: A stronger plain beer, made from your own Brewery materials. DRAFT.
